name: Spark-Chime
description: A bright strike, then a rippling bell chime with a sparkly shimmer and an echo, about 1.8 s, fading out. Computed sample by sample in JavaScript (src/effects/sparkSound.js).

name: Light-Swell
description: A glassy ping as the light flares, then a warm, bright chord that swells and holds while it shines, with an airy shimmer and twinkles, fading out (3.3 s). Computed sample by sample in JavaScript (src/effects/lightSound.js).

name: Fire-Crackle
description: A rushing whoosh and roar with crackles and pops, building for 0.9 s like the fireball, then dying away (2 s). Computed sample by sample in JavaScript (src/effects/fireSound.js).

name: Clock-Tick
description: A clock ticking fast, then gradually slowing down, each tick lower and longer, over a low tone sliding down, ending with a soft low bell as it stops (4.2 s). The ticks match the Clock animation's second hand. Computed sample by sample in JavaScript (src/effects/clockSound.js).

name: Growth
description: Wood creaking and groaning with a few sharp cracks while the branch grows, softening into a gentle leafy rustle as the sprout opens (3.6 s). Computed sample by sample in JavaScript (src/effects/growthSound.js).
